exposure.needed: whether any Kafka clusters in the environment are ZooKeeper-based rather than KRaft-based

consequence.statement: Operators must ensure all their Kafka clusters are using KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer; with ZooKeeper-based clusters and the ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration support removed, an environment that does not do this first has no supported ZooKeeper-based path after the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Migrate all Kafka clusters to KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer; the ZooKeeper-based mode and the ZK-to-KRaft migration are no longer supported afterwards.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters and for migrating ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft, so all clusters must already be using KRaft before upgrading to 0.46.0 or newer.
